content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka numme pumme nakatzimodu ka pabatsekoo nanesootuhi nobe-kwi'yoona mea'a, numme yise ka nanesootuhi nobe-kwitu apegeamo'o.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ne netamma, “Besa oo poonne ka nanesootuhi nobe maasoo puu tupe namadabuena ka saa'a mu tupe no'yoona abedikwu gi sumu'yoo sapa wunukwu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka tutsekoo giba Olive mee naneadu-ma poyase onow katu. Numme yise numu-wana'yoona mee oo tubenga, “Ha'oo saa'a numme oo sopedakwadoo tabuadooa hannano'o yoo namanese u kodyu petukwu ka yaatu teepu atasoo u mayugwekwu?”
Soo Te Pabe'e mee ne nanekwegea, “Besa sapa gi kumma'akusoo numu mumme nemooagadu naka'oedyukupana.
Ewa'yoo soo numu mee sumuna mu netammakwu, ‘Nu yow Mu Pabe'e,’ yise ewow numu nemoo'aga.
Mu ka tu nana'akwe-kwitu nakakwu, tooetoo nana'akwekwu pana gi suipana. Tooe tu nana'akwedyakwe sapa gisoo atasoo ka yaatu teepu e yugwekwi manakwe.
Yoo namanekwu ka hemma suda manekwuse. Ewa-baatu numu kukumma'yoosoo nanagoena, tukapu natugena natseagoena, soo teepu yise yutsungayikwu.
Saa'a numu mu wohonena ka mu numu moohedu mumme goe tuungukwu. No'obatusoo mu numu gi mu petzabekwu nu-koobatoo.
Ewa'yoo mu tunaka'oedyukudu-matu gi nu-kwi tunaka'oedyuku manese gi nanapetzabena nanakwohonekwu.
Ewa'yoo numu nu yow Te Naa yadooawabe mee naneyugwedu mu-baa petuse ewow numu nemooagakwu.
Yise ewa'yoosoo soo numu suda tumatuguna tooe no'yoona mu numu gi nanapetzape manekwu.
Pana mu sakwa ooosapa tunaka'oedyuku tooe mu numu mumme tumoo'oo, o'no mu namagwetzoikwu.
Mooe'ugasoo no'obatusoo numu ka Te Naa besa na'unnedu natuukwekwu. Umu punno'o oo naka ka Te Naa numu magwetzoikwuna. O'no yise nu ka yaatu teepu atasoo yugwekwu.
Tooe hemma tooe suta'yoo ka nananesootuhi nobe-kobena natzekwunukukwu. O'nosoo soo Te Naa yadooawabe Daniel mee naneadu yoo eka sutakoo
namadabuena pumatoo tu nananesootuhikwuna botugupu.
O'no sakwa mu ka oo poonnese, Judea-wi'yoona yabesoo mea'a.
Mu ka ona puuwana'yoona mu sakwa gi hemma hanepana mea'ahootooe.
Ka oona tubewabe-kwi'yoona mu sakwa gi mu wegea-kwitoo kodyupana.
Mu momoko'ne kokoheadu yise mu nunuupetzekudu tutuha namanatzayakwe ka numu tuyamanese.
Umu sakwa nanesootuhi, gi sakwa tommo tooetoo te nanesootuhi tabeno hee oo suda manepana.
O'no numu nanasuda manekwu. Gi hannano'o oo suda namatugupu-ga'yoo.
Soo Te Naa umu tu nanumu tutuha soobedyana mu sootuhina ka suda mu nuugwena tzadyooikuse, o'no mu tunaka'oedyukudu namagwetzoikwu.
Tooe haga tooe sumuna meeoo mu tuukwekwu, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e mooasoo kodyu petu,’ mee, gi oo naka'oedyukupana.

Ewa tuwazoo na'esagoekwu, ‘Nu yow Mu Pabe'e mee na'unnekwu.’ Ewasoo mu numu moohedu numu nemooagayakwe. Ewa nanasookwugi hemma mu tzapoonnekukwu tooe hemma tooe mahanekwu ka umu e dooamu too'e nemooagana.
Nu yaa meno'o ekow mu tuukwe'e.
Ka tooe haga tooe mumme mee tuukwe, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e numme-baa, tooetoo mana numu-wanakoo oo nanepoonne, tooetoo ebe nobe-kwi,’ mee mu unakwe sapa gi oo poonne-gapana, gi mu naka'oedyukupana.
Nu ka numu poowutzaba-kwa'ne oo yabe manikwu ka tukwukwetseba tabatsebue-nakwana ka koomeba pedakwana ka taba egea-tamme mani-kwa'nekoosoo, nu mu-baa kodyu petuhookwu soo numu no'yoona e poonnekwu.
O mu e naka'oedyukudu suu'mu nu-baa sumuhookwu.
O'no ka gi hemma besa manekwuse, soo taba toganohookwu, soo muha punno'o. Mu paatoosooba punno'o sawedyikwu.
No'yoona mu numu punno'o ka koomeba-nagakoo e pooha kodyu petukwuna poonnekwu. No'obatusoo gi tunaka'oedyukudu numu suda sokwamakwu.

Soo tumooyagakunoo paba namooyagakuhookwu, ka e kemmana mu tuukwena. Nu ka mu nuka tummatzidu toha kakasa-gakoo, mooe tayakwu umuoo saa'a umu nuga tutzeana nu-kwi tunaka'oedyukudu manatutooe tsobakwu.
Ka sunngabe pooedooakese, mu meeoo sokwamadooa, tamme tookwa tamatsebooe.
Ka gi besa hemma manekese, mu yise oo sopedakwadookwu, nu tookwa pudusoo kodyu petukwu.
Susumudu mu numu-matu ka hemma oo manedu poonnekwu gisoo ya'ena.
Nuga unnepu besa na'unnedu, gi atasoo mane-wa'ne'yoo.

Ka hannano'o oe e petuookwuna manepetuse gi haga ka teepu-koobatu oo sopedakwatoo. Mu toogoopatu Te Naa tutummatzidu puu gi, nu punno'o gi. Te Naa suu'mu oo sopedakwatoopunne ka hannano'o e petuookwuna.

Nu sumuna yabesoo umu-baa kodyu petukwu gi mu numu meeoo sokwamano'o. Ka gisoo e petu mu numu tooe how tooe ma'na'wekwu. Ka o'nosoo tu mane-kwa'nesoo ka nana Noah mee naneadu togesoo ka yaa teepu-kooba gwetzoinumme. Umu puu tukana, hebena, nananodukwadooyakwe ka o'no tabeno ka Noah ka sake-wi natzatumase. Mu numu puu ka gi ka Noah nakaheesoobedyana. O'no umu puu ka teepu patatzopahoose, batatuihoo ka gi oo nakaheesoobedyana. Ooosoo tuwazoo manekwu ka e kodyu petuse.
Sumuna waha'yoo nanana ka tubewabe-wi'yoona, sumu'yoo nakwuhoogase, sumu'yoo nabenihookwu.
Sumuna waha'yoo momoko'ne toosoona, sumu'yoo nakwuhoogase, sumu'yoo nabenihookwu.
Mu sakwa nonotsu tabeno nuummabetsabena. Tooe hannano'o tooe nu kemmowgena, yongona, togano, awamooasoo. Nu sumuna gi mu nuummabetsabe mu mayu petukwu.
Mu sakwa namabetzapepunne ka e kodyu petukwuna wutooena, soo numu puu namabetzapepunne ka tu nobe-kwitu natuduhakwuna sopedakwatoona, o'no soo hemma tuduhakwudu gi mu hemma tuduha-wa'ne'yoo.
Mu sakwa yise ooosapa namabetzapepunne nu mu-baa petuhookwu gi meeoo mu sokwamano'o.”

Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo tuwazoo unakwe, “Umu nuga besa yadooawabe mu e dooamu nehane aatakwu, unu sokwamana sakwa ooosapa besa e dooamu tummatzi. Umu yise ka nuka naka'oedyukudu nemabetseana ka e besa unnepu mu tunedyooena.
Nu ka kodyu petuse umu e netutzeana ka umu nuka naka'oedyukudu besa mu nemabetsea mu mayu petuse, nu besa mu sootuhikwu.
O'no umu e hemma no'oko nemadunagakwu.
Pana soo e yadooawabe ka suda tusooyugwena, gi yabesoo e petukwuna sookana.
Oosoo yise umu tunaka'oedyukudu gi mu nemabetseana, tukana, ewa hebena mesoo baaya'ena tooe how tooe manekwu.
Nu yise gi oo soonamme-kwa'ne yabesoo kodyu petukwu. Nu yise ka umu gi tunaka'oedyukudu-noko oo tatsungukwu. O'no oosoo mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu-no suda sokwamano'o.”

footnotes.text: Tamme sakwa oo nakasopedakwatoo ka hemma sutakoo ka Te Pabe'e tamme tunesootabue-kwi.
